errors.error_description: Introduced an incomplete conditional in a combinational always block, omitting the else/default paths so 'code' is not assigned when en is low or for certain input patterns, inferring a latch.
Declared an internal net that is left unconnected and unused, representing an unconnected internal net.
Drove an input port using a continuous assign, violating port direction/type rules by assigning to an input variable.
Instantiated a gate primitive with a port width mismatch (8-bit data/out versus 6-bit control), creating a structural boundary defect.
